thesis: Buying into a confirmed, extreme risk-off tape (QQQ below 50/200-day, VIX at the 99th percentile) is poor timing even for a stock holding its own. The earnings pop to 31.0 on 11/06 reversed to a 28.49 close and the stock has since drifted from 29.71 to 28.25, which looks like distribution into strength. Price sits above the mean analyst target of 24.5 with a 'Reduce' consensus, and the CFO sold near 30. The proposed stop is only about 0.7 ATR, so ordinary noise in a VIX-31 market can stop the trade out before the thesis is tested. With 21.7% short interest, reversals cut both ways, and leverage is meaningful against thin free cash flow.
